scope: Only STAGING_HTTP + --run + PASS is focused live evidence. OFFLINE_MOCK is offline only. Prepare/Inspect are not test passes.

results.name: Client registration and login
remainingAssertions: Register a synthetic Client, confirm through isolated mail capture, test the nine selected-role/account-role combinations, invalid credentials and missing profile; assert mismatch logout/cache removal and no workspace redirect.

results.name: Provider registration and login
remainingAssertions: Register a synthetic Provider; verify Auth trigger persists only Client/Provider and ignores forged Admin metadata; test confirmation, recovery and session revocation with mail capture.

results.name: Mandatory identity verification
remainingAssertions: Submit inert generated PDF/PNG, explicit true consents, owned paths; race two submissions, expect exactly one pending. Deny false/omitted consent, forged role/reviewer/status and foreign/missing document.

results.name: Admin approval and rejection
remainingAssertions: With existing synthetic Admin approve pending consented Client/Provider, reject with reason, resubmit; assert users flags and Provider badge atomically agree. Replayed final decisions denied without duplicate notifications.

results.name: Pending/rejected user access denial
remainingAssertions: Full workspace endpoint/state matrix and UI route guards

results.name: Direct REST restrictions
remainingAssertions: Operator ACL/default grants/views/GraphQL review; authority PATCH probe

results.name: RPC authorization
remainingAssertions: Every RPC and caller-state combination; private helper routing

results.name: Private Storage access
remainingAssertions: Identity/report files, overwrite/delete races, signed URL expiry, payment proof ownership writes

results.name: Client request creation
remainingAssertions: Approved Client creates correct category/specialization/date/time/GPS. Race identical idempotency key, expect one request/ID; simulate lost response and retry, expect original ID; changed details same key must fail. Preserve image-failure edit retry.

results.name: Recommendation accuracy
remainingAssertions: Independent fixture completeness and UI recommendation rendering

results.name: Provider selection
remainingAssertions: Client selects only from own pending request and eligible target; reject forged/inactive/unapproved/unavailable/declined/conflicting target. Exact repeat is idempotent. Provider cannot browse other open requests or apply.

results.name: Provider confirm and decline
remainingAssertions: Confirm conflict/replay and concurrent stale transitions

results.name: Messaging
remainingAssertions: Former Provider, suspended/revoked JWT and browser draft/thread navigation

results.name: Service completion
remainingAssertions: Provider starts only confirmed own service; Client completes only own in-progress service. Race cancel/start/complete, assert valid serial result and history retained. Validate repeat versus stale transition behavior.

results.name: Payment recording
remainingAssertions: After completion Client records Cash or transfer with owned private proof. Race duplicate request payment, expect one. Deny wrong payer/provider/amount/method/missing transfer proof. Resolve consistent path and legacy URL-only proofs; reject foreign URL, mismatched path, traversal, ambiguous ID, missing/foreign object; no public URL persistence.

results.name: Ratings and reviews
remainingAssertions: Both participants can review completed service once; race duplicates and enforce rating range/participant pairing. Deny premature/wrong target review. Compare recommendation aggregate across all records, no browser-limited statistics.

results.name: Admin monitoring
remainingAssertions: Report review writes, inactive Admin and 101-row queue pagination

results.name: Account suspension
remainingAssertions: Admin RPC must use account_status, suspend synthetic Client/Provider with active work; direct REST reads/writes/RPCs denied after status change; preserve all assignments/history. Test cross-tab sign-out and invalid refresh tokens; decide self/last-Admin policy separately.

results.name: Concurrent Provider assignments
remainingAssertions: Operator barriers and profile/confirm/decline/suspension interleavings

results.name: Atomic Provider profile updates
remainingAssertions: Snapshot synthetic profile/skills/specs/hours/own basic fields; inject late unique/validation failure inside single RPC and compare every set unchanged. Successful save commits all sets; concurrent two saves yields one complete set, never mixed rows. Race with selection/suspension and check eligibility reflects committed state.
